ns2:section.sectionText: Honors section. Grade of A in Math 231 or score of 5 on AP Calculus BC exam required. Not all qualified students will get seats in honors calculus, so incoming freshmen should register for a regular section as a backup plan. The course will open to students with a 5 on AP Calculus BC at 9:00am on Friday, August 20, 2021. Continuing students with an A in Math 231 should email mathadvising@illinois.edu <mailto:mathadvising@illinois.edu> with name, UIN, and reason for interest to request approval for this section. Students with a 6 or 7 on the IB Further Math HL should also contact mathadvising@illinois.edu <mailto:mathadvising@illinois.edu> .
